#ifndef WIDGET_H
#define WIDGET_H

struct Widget {
    int id;
    int flags;
};

// Headers commonly carry small inline functions alongside pure
// declarations; only the inline definition below contributes a row.
int widget_is_active(const struct Widget* w);

static inline int widget_is_visible(const struct Widget* w) {
    if (w == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return (w->flags & 1) != 0 || (w->flags & 2) != 0;
}

#endif
